generate.description: Synthesize multi-storey structural frames from parametric parameters with strict spatial hierarchy rules. A secondary grounded assistant handles spatial queries and storey synthesis before detached round-trip semantic validation ensures clean, verified IFC export.
generate.lead: Parametric building synthesis and detached ISO 10303-21 persistence.
generate.title: Generate & export

inspect.description: Load and parse ISO 16739 IFC4 and IFC2x3 files directly in browser memory via native WebAssembly. Traverse full spatial containment trees, query property sets, and generate orthographic 2D floor plans at storey elevations without cloud dependencies.
inspect.lead: Client-side spatial parsing and property extraction.
inspect.title: Inspect IFC

modify.description: Execute 3D coordinate translations, relative vector rotations, and element deletions. Every modification is isolated in a non-destructive proxy layer and logged chronologically in an immutable JSON ChangeSet with full undo and redo capability.
modify.lead: Non-destructive proxy transforms and transactional audit logs.
modify.title: Modify models

finalCta.body: Design, inspect and modify IFC models directly in your browser.
finalCta.heading: Open your model.
finalCta.standards: 100% Client-Side WebAssembly · Open Standard IFC4 & IFC2x3

productPreview.captionDesc: SPATIAL BIM TREE, ELEMENT INSPECTOR & 3D VIEWPORT

edit.subtitle: Non-Destructive Edits

export.description: Execute detached semantic verification before exporting pure ISO 10303-21 IFC files.
